card.name: Words just before a US place or name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as as, than, to, for and a, or list markers, right before a place name or proper noun is expected. Seen mostly in general web text about US regions, parks and outdoor activities.

modes.label: Comparison words before a place
modes.description: The words as or than in a comparison that is about to name a US state or a similar place.
modes.example: a distinction as uniquely Californian<< as>> the fish she was now holding at eye

modes.label: Links in place lists
modes.description: Words like to or for that link regions or activities, right before the next name in a list.
modes.example: the North Woods from Maine<< to>> Minnesota also remain at frontier density

modes.label: Outdoor-people words
modes.description: The start of words for hunters or hikers, or an answer-list marker in a quiz.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, with a slight hint of American-name words being suppressed.
